item.title: Fire Emblem and its Little White Lies
item.description: Fire emblem is a popular strategy video game. There are currently 16 games in the franchise and I’ve played the majority of them. For those unfamiliar you have a roster of interesting characters that act on a field with a grid. On that grid there is an enemy army, one you’re tasked with defeating. It has objectives like defeating the boss, routing the entire enemy force, or defending a point from waves of reinforcements.
